headline: Fines for Businesses Saying 'DM for Price Information': 8.2 Million TL
summary: Turkey's ministry says the EİDS application requires identity and authority verification for electronic real estate and vehicle listings, including on Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. Fines totalling 8.2 million lira were reported.
why: Consumer and advertising regulation in Turkey affects how real estate and vehicle sellers, including online platforms, must verify listings and handle sales.
